# Spring Framework source evidence

These unmodified source files are from Spring Framework 7.0.9, commit
82a6b40b9366ec181ededdad282b307ee5381a52, under Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt).
Original copyright headers remain intact. They provide full-file hash regression
evidence for the eight reviewed cross-section links; they are not complete docs.
The recipe/source acquisition layer must authenticate the checkout separately.
